about: Capability vectors computed by ikigai-core from tests/vectors/capability_cases.json (crates/ikigai-vocab/tests/capability_vectors.rs, which fails if this file differs from what it computes). A capability is "root" or the list of scopes it holds; verbs are spelled as ikigai_core::Verb serializes them; a denial is the text of the kernel's Denied, null when the floor admits the request.

denials.denied: capability does not grant `urn:cap:script:run:open-*` (declared by `urn:script:open-door`; any grant under `urn:cap:script:run:open-` satisfies it)
denials.name: family

denials.denied: capability does not grant `*` (declared by `urn:x`; any grant at all satisfies it)
denials.name: star

denials.denied: capability does not grant `urn:cap:net:*` (declared by `urn:net`; any grant under `urn:cap:net:` satisfies it)
denials.name: net-unrelated

denials.denied: capability does not grant `urn:cap:net:*` (declared by `urn:fetch`; any grant under `urn:cap:net:` satisfies it)
denials.name: first-unsatisfied-first
